integrity: The full primary source was inspected around the family definition and its small-parameter nonstarlikeness theorem. The extension is proved analytically from the exact boundary Herglotz formulas: a unique boundary zero of the derivative is located, the radial imaginary part is factored exactly, and the sign change of the starlikeness quotient follows by continuity. A symbolic checker verifies the algebraic identities but is not used as a substitute for the infinite-domain proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies nonstarlikeness for every unequal weight in the specific orthogonal two-rotation family. It does not decide the balanced midpoint s=1/2, does not treat arbitrary angular separations of Herglotz atoms, and does not give a general class-wide criterion for positive-real-derivative functions.
title: Every imbalanced orthogonal Herglotz mixture is nonstarlike
